title: Attack-surface pack (P291, CR07/CR08/CR13-CR16/CR25/CR26/CR31)
notes: Names the P291 rules read; dangling-DNS facts are passive (or from an ACTIVE module that ran under the gate). Takeovers are never claimed to prove them.

attributes.takeover_fingerprint: provider unclaimed-resource fingerprint matched for the name: {service, fingerprint, source, observed_at, url} or a list of them (an indexed page or an authorized fetch; the resource is never claimed or registered, CR07)
attributes.cname_dangling: the CNAME target of the name does not resolve: {target, status ('NXDOMAIN'), confirmed (bool: a second resolver confirmed it), source, observed_at}; only a confirmed NXDOMAIN is dangling evidence (CR07)
attributes.vulns_verified: list of CVE ids the source verified on the host beyond a version string (e.g. Shodan 'verified', a CVE-specific check, or an authorized ACTIVE check): CR15 'verified'

tags.in_scope: entity matches the ACTIVE scope file of the run (A7): set by the core only; pivots never inherit it and SAN affiliates or co-hosted names never join the scope
